user_request: Launch a long PI-DeepONet training run on the complete training dataset.
hypothesis: Extending the audited discrete PI-DeepONet objective from the completed short parent to 100 full-support epochs will reduce the fixed train-selection aggregate relative L2 from 0.913795542875158 to at most 0.50 without non-finite optimization.
expected_mechanism: Every epoch covers all 2240 train records with appearance-varying exact saved frames; repeated full-support exposure should reduce the undertraining floor while retaining the source-consistent LWC84 physics regularizer.
primary_metric: aggregate relative L2 on the fixed 48-record train-only selection panel
failure_signal: Any non-finite gradient, worker or supervisor failure, missing atomic rolling checkpoint, invalid binding, or no improvement below the parent train-selection score by epoch 10.
single_conceptual_change: Increase the PI-DeepONet full-support training budget from 3 epochs to 100 epochs; architecture, loss, optimizer hyperparameters, data manifest, and train-only selection protocol remain fixed.
claim_scope: comparison_only unless a separately preregistered same-protocol gate later passes
rollback: Preserve the r6 parent and every existing A3, B2-H, Helmholtz, ASAM, and CPADC checkpoint. Stop the isolated r7 run on failure and retain its latest atomic checkpoint and logs.
